svg.desc: Learning journey: May 2026 first 14-page HTML/CSS website (Project-PWD); June 2026 responsive rebuild (Project-PWD); August 2026 DyslexiaHub, a dyslexia-friendly learning site; August 2026 BioNotes-Ai, first JavaScript data-driven app.
